cards.subject: Gurubashi jungle
lines: All of this was rainforest and it belonged to the trolls. The Sundering broke the landmass and the territory swiftly became desert.
The Farraki were stranded here when it happened. They adapted, and became sand trolls. Zul'Farrak is what they built afterwards.

cards.subject: The crater in the east
lines: The hole is here, and the tunnel at the bottom of it is sealed. The wiki's own caption for the picture: "the sealed entrance before the caverns were opened."
Old Hillsbrad and the Black Morass are Burning Crusade.
In here it is a hole in the desert with a locked door at the end.

cards.subject: Anachronos stands outside it
lines: The bronze dragon runs the Scepter of the Shifting Sands chain — the one that opens Ahn'Qiraj — from the dirt outside a door he cannot open for you.
He was only moved inside the caverns in 4.0.3a.
In here, he is standing in a sandpit.

cards.subject: The other sealed door
lines: The south of this zone holds an impenetrable gate into Uldum, and Uldum does not exist as a place you can go.
It gets cracked open four expansions later, and the tunnel beyond has collapsed by then.
Two doors in one desert, and neither of them opens.

cards.subject: Why there is a dragon in the desert
lines: The hole in south Tanaris is one of the most active silithid hives there is.
The bugs out of these holes attacked Anachronos and the Caverns of Time. That attack is what set off the War of the Shifting Sands.
The crater and the chasm are the same story.

cards.subject: The Noggenfogger Elixir
lines: You do not choose which. There is no cooldown, so people drink until they get the one they want.
Drinking more stacks the effects on top of each other, which is why a tiny skeleton is a normal sight in Gadgetzan.
The skeleton model is lifted straight off the game's own skeletal fiends.

cards.subject: What it is made of
lines: Dew from thistleshrub glands, mixed with powder from Violet Tragan mushrooms.
The walking thorn-bushes in the southeast are the base ingredient.
The most famous item in the zone is squeezed out of its most forgettable mob.

cards.subject: The chicken walks east
lines: The crashed robot sits in the mountains near the Gaping Chasm. Escort it and it walks to the crater, then rockets away to Booty Bay.
In here there are two ambushes on the route. One of them was deleted years later.
"Emergency power activated! Initializing ambulatory motor! CLUCK!"

cards.subject: It's a Secret to Everybody
lines: Summoning the elemental on the eastern peninsula is step eleven of a full Legend of Zelda parody, built around a gnome who washed up in Un'Goro with amnesia.
His name is Linken.
The chain is neutral — both factions run the same one.

cards.subject: Steamwheedle Port
cards.tag: The quietest place in the zone
lines: A little goblin dock on the east coast, and its most important resident is a troll called Yeh'kinya, studying the essence of an ancient god.
He is the thread that runs to the Sunken Temple, and to Hakkar.
The Hakkari plot is being run out of a fishing pier.

cards.subject: Lost Rigger Cove
cards.tag: They are building ships in it
lines: The pirate cove in the far east is walled by mountains on three sides, and the Southsea are not just anchored there — there is a shipyard.
They get their water the honest goblin way: raid for it, or sail up the coast and resupply.
In a desert where water is the only currency, the pirates solved it with a boat.

cards.subject: Land's End Beach
lines: Sea giant country. Walking onto the wrong sand at forty-five is simply death.
The same coastline is a standard turtle-scale run — the turtles here go up into the fifties.

cards.subject: The door in the far northwest
lines: The longest ride from Gadgetzan there is, which is why everyone summons instead.
Worth knowing before you knock: a band of mercenaries fled Gadgetzan, wandered into that city and got trapped in it.
Sergeant Bly and his crew are still in there.
